name: Alaska
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. Alaska's extent, CLIPPED AT THE ANTIMERIDIAN (-180). A PMTiles bbox and Web Mercator tile ranges cannot wrap, so everything west of 180 degrees is left out: the Rat and Near Islands of the western Aleutians (Attu, Agattu, Shemya, Kiska, Amchitka, Semisopochnoi). Kept: the Aleutians east of 180 (Amatignak at 51.2N, 179.1W sets the south edge), Point Barrow (71.4N) in the north, and the panhandle to the Portland Canal (-129.97) in the east. The Bering Sea, Gulf of Alaska and parts of Yukon and British Columbia inside the box cannot be trimmed with a rectangle. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-ak.
